editorial.name: Clutch
editorial.descriptionZh: Clutch 管的是非人类身份：云上、代码里和 AI Agent 用的账号、密钥与凭据，靠一张 Identity Lineage® Graph 把它们连回来源、归属和消费者。首屏是一圈黑白圆盘围着圆心排开。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看安全产品怎么用黑白图形把抽象概念讲清
editorial.noteZh: 首屏用超大字号分三行写 Every Identity. Every Agent. Every Secret.，前两段是黑、后面转成浅灰，副标是 Discover, Govern, and Secure Your Entire Non-Human Attack Surface. Cloud to code to AI；主视觉一圈带图标的黑色圆盘围绕中心一个 C 形标志排开，底下压着渐隐的阴影。正文 They Exist Everywhere. They're Managed Nowhere. 用一条对照讲 MANAGED、MULTIPLYING 与 100X MORE THAN HUMANS，并提出 Identity Lineage® Graph——把每个实体连回 its origin, the people behind it, where it's stored, what consumes it, and the resources it reaches。What Clutch Secures. 一段明确分三块：IDENTITIES、AI AGENTS、SECRETS，每块都配 Discovery & Inventory、Lifecycle Management 或 Agent Guardrails、Posture & Risk Management、Threat Detection & Response 的对应项。站内另有 /nhi/…、/agentic-ai/…、/secrets/… 三组路径与一个 Masterclass。

reasons.statement: 站点是 Clutch 这款非人类身份安全平台自己的官网，首屏三行标题与 What Clutch Secures 的分块都指向它的产品，按产品与公司官网归档；候选池由 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感提供。
